title: We've been building an AI tool that creates Unity games from text. Here’s a preview of what it can do so far.
author: PigeonMaster2000
selftext: I'd love to hear your thoughts on it!

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body: Local generation one time payment, or yet another wrapper service?

replies.author: cutcss
replies.body: Look into your heart, you knew the answer long before you posted this comment 💔

replies.author: RemarkableGuidance44
replies.body: Another Pay Per Token Service. Using Meshy, Claude, ChatGPT.

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body:
„Create anything“ is pushing it too high tbh. Just be honest about it. Some stuff looked helpful, like particles etc. will check that out for sure! But 3D Models? Common. There is a reason you just showed them from far away. There are better tools out there already. But if it helps making them more performance/game engine ready, that would be interesting. Furthermore, there are a few other tools already that create scripts and logic. What differences your tool from others? How complex can it be? What are the limits? Can it create entire scenes + scripts for me by using Natural Language only?

I am interested, but sceptical when someone is pushing too hard.

replies.author: imnotabot303
replies.body: This is what 99% of AI tools pushed here are. Overhyped nonsense that are just trying to appeal to the people that have zero knowledge of game dev or asset creation and just want an easy mode button.

comments.author: superkickstart
comments.body:
I wish there would be actually honest AI tool/service. These "create everything" or "production quality" promises never deliver.


I hope the bubble pops.
